posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
There has been a lot of talk about this, and I'll probably be ninjaed and/or corrected about this.

 

As far as I remember we have at least 2 expansions coming. Wrath of the Cosmos is confirmed on the Vengeance box, it will probably be a 2 hero, 2 environment, 4 villain expansion, to match up with Shattered Timelines like Rook City and Infernal Relics did. The final expansion of the game is, I believe, confirmed to be a mega-expansion like Vengeance.

There will most likely also be an unknown number of mini-expansions during this time as well.

A lot of people have done the number crunching on heros vs villains and nemesis numbers, and we have come to a tentative conclusion that the mega-expansion will most likely contain at least one villain turned hero, most likely The Matriarch... though we haven't considered the opposite case too much, which is that the villains will be re-done as different villains, becuase it seems less likely.

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
There are only 2 expansions post Vengeance. I am relativly sure that has been confirmed. One standard expansion (like RC, IR, and ST) and one Mega Expansion. 

I'v run the numbers before elsewhere, but the short/short of it is that the final large Expansion will have at least 4 villains. My money is on 5. There will either be (A) No new hero decks (B) Villains turned into hero decks (to help combat the Cosmic Entity) (C) New heros that use old Nemesis symbols (least likely imo)

Having 4 new Villains, plus the Cosmic Entity fight, and a few bonus Villains-turned-hero decks would certainly fit the billing of "Mega Expansion" in the same way the Vengeance format did. But those are just my guesses.

posts.name: TheSoundOfTrees
posts.cooked:
The most intriguing "clue" is that ALL known heroes and 3 unknown ones have a nemesis in Vengeance ( counting the Five + their cards) - maybe suggesting that there is only three heroes left…

Right now, based on numbers, box size, content and gameplay, my hypothesis is that we may see a mini-expansion with a hero, maybe one other with a villain, roughly at the same time as Wrath of the Cosmos, and after that probably an expansion with only villains (the classic "nemesis" villain with one deck) and environments, no heroes.  it would be enough to have a full roster of hero/villain pairs, ending the "cycle".

However there is a lot of potential for more "villain teams", mega-villains, villains who are not a character, and other forms of gameplay we haven't seen yet, some of them very different from what we are used to.

So, for me, it's "at least two" - I'd like to believe that Vengeance was only the beginning of the "second cycle" (or the "second big box"), and a third will follow. There is still a lot to tell, in my opinion. But Visionary refuses to speak - and Citizen Confusion ( also known as Citizen [REDACTED]) won't help .

For now.

posts.name: Yak Guardian
posts.cooked:
Ignoring Iron Legacy (who is more of a mega-villain) and Vengeful 5 (who aren't intended to be played in the standard fashion) there are six** heroes without a major (i.e. Villain Card + 25-card deck) Nemesis Villain.

 

Assuming Wrath is 2H/4V/2E as the previous expansions, and assuming that the 2 Heroes have their Nemesis in the set, and assuming that the other 2 Villains match up with previous Heroes, (OK that's a lot of [CENSORED] assuming) we'd still need 4 more Villains to complete the Nemesis match-ups, which seems like something that they would be likely to do.

 

So 1 standard expansion (Wrath) and 1 mega (with 4 Nemesis Villains and enough unknown stuff to count as a "Mega") does seem to make sense.

 

Mind you, I'd love to see a new expansions come out on a regular basis for as long as >G can come up with cool stuff for us (which seems likely to be forever), but the 1 standard + 1 mega fits what we already have and already know.

 

**(Absolute Zero, Bunker, K.N.Y.F.E., The Naturalist, The Scholar, and Unity for those who don't have a quick reference sheet in front of them)
